about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Jammer Dash, a quick-paced 2D rhythm-platformer that puts your timing and reflexes to the test! Every step counts in this game as you shoot cubes and dodge deadly saws—in sync with every beat of a pulsating soundtrack.

Whether you're a hardcore rhythm enthusiast or a casual gamer, Jammer Dash offers an exhilarating mix of high-speed platforming and musical challenge. Create your own levels with the powerful built-in level editor: import your favorite music and create custom stages that let you flaunt your style while keeping your toes tapping.

Challenge yourself to earn skill points, beat your high scores, and climb leaderboards, all while competing in a world that expands to the music. With addictive gameplay, customized levels, and social features, Jammer Dash dares you to see how far rhythm will take you.

Inspired by many awesome games such as Muse Dash, Geometry Dash and osu!. Made in Unity and C#.

short_description: Jammer Dash is your average 2D rhythm-platformer in which your every step is dependent on hits on the beat. Smash cubes, avoid fatal saws, and ride through colorful levels in time with music. Make your own levels with an incredibly powerful level editor and jam to your favorite songs!
